versions.changelog:
Initial release of 专业需求分析师 (requirements-analysis):

- Enables multi-step, dialogue-based extraction and documentation of requirements from brief ideas.
- Supports decomposition of EPICs into detailed requirements and user stories.
- Integrates multiple prioritization methods (MoSCoW, RICE, Kano, etc.).
- Guides identification of stakeholders and dependencies.
- Provides structured templates for requirement specification and documentation.
- Includes best practices, common pitfalls, and extensive reference materials.
